What changes, and why (one or two sentences):

Checklist:

- [ ] No game files: no disk or tape images, extracted binaries, snapshots or RVM states (they contain the original game's memory), nothing from `extended/`, no third-party source or data
- [ ] `make check` passes (the 64K source still assembles to the original bytes) and, for code, `make test`
- [ ] Docs updated where a fact changed; `README.md` names no mission
- [ ] Commits are small and use explicit paths; no attribution trailers
